y_failures: Cites Opticks p.14 (the preface/Advertisement) for Queries on the 'vegetation' of metals, and Phil. Trans. p.333 (a plain review of the Principia) for 'active principles... traced to his Hermetic and alchemical interests'; neither page supports these claims.
reason: X's quotation from MS Add.3973 p.43 and its description of p.51 match the page text, and it clearly answers that Newton published almost nothing on alchemy, with useful context on De Natura Acidorum and the Opticks Queries.
